fusions.name: Slipped Edge
fusions.desc: Flicks a strand-bound blade that deals 5 damage to one enemy within 7 tiles, and up to 2 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Fan of Cuts
fusions.desc: Looses 4 strands at once, spread apart; each deals 5 damage. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Edge Out
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Waiting Cut
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
